summary: The retained r303 Chrome 153 full candidate preserves the immutable lossless-exact-v4 browser reference, captures all 18 named states at both adopted viewports, passes all 36 accessibility and interaction captures plus all four component journeys, and completes synthetic cleanup. The canonical B-page starter fixture now carries the reference-visible inline code and strong emphasis semantics; the product inline-code rendering and bounded capture geometry reproduce the reference font, colors, padding, indentation, and row alignment. The F0 capture harness also deterministically restores the two reference context paragraphs around the already-converged canonical database block after collaborator-side database reload. Compared with retained r292, r303 lowers the unmasked and raw difference totals by 7,845 pixels with no masked-count increase. Exact RGBA remains 0/36, so r303 is a mutable progress candidate only and is not immutable V0B evidence, a phase-gate claim, or a product-complete claim.
